summary.text: Carter Barrett is a Republican state representative from Georgia House District 24 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business executive who earned a B.B.A. from the University of Georgia and has worked in community banking and as a founding partner of Dime Capital.

paragraphs.text: Barrett lives in Cumming, Georgia, and earned a B.B.A. from the University of Georgia.

His career experience includes serving as a founding partner of Dime Capital, as market president of North Atlanta with Affinity Bank, and as regional president of North Atlanta with Community & Southern Bank.
Barrett assumed office in the Georgia House on January 9, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Appropriations Committee, the Banks and Banking Committee, the Code Revision Committee and the House Higher Education Committee, where he is vice chair.
